explication: Logto is an authentication and identity platform for SaaS and AI applications. A user starts a sign-in or account-management flow in the hosted Experience or Account Center, which calls Core authentication routes. Core validates interaction state, MFA and profile changes, persists identity state, and returns protocol results to the application. Connectors extend authentication to social, enterprise, email, and SMS providers, while the Console and Management API configure tenants, organizations, SSO, and RBAC. Sampled files strongly support profile/MFA handling and browser-state persistence; several broader subsystems are represented from the README and tree only.
